inventory.question: Have you listed every child you claim for the child tax credit on your 2025 return?
Have you listed every child who could be a qualifying child for the earned income credit on your 2025 return, even if you are not sure the child qualifies?
Have you recorded every mortgage interest amount in box 1 of every Form 1098 you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every student loan interest amount in box 1 of every Form 1098-E you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every covered long-term sale (a sale of an investment you held more than a year, with your cost basis reported to the IRS) on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded the cost basis of every covered long-term sale on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded the sale proceeds of every covered long-term sale on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every covered short-term sale (a sale of an investment you held a year or less, with your cost basis reported to the IRS) on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded the cost basis of every covered short-term sale on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded the sale proceeds of every covered short-term sale on every Form 1099-B you or your spouse received for 2025?

Have you recorded every market discount amount in box 10 of every Form 1099-INT you or your spouse received for 2025 for which you elected to include market discount in income each year?
Have you recorded every amount of interest on U.S. savings bonds and Treasury obligations in box 3 of every Form 1099-INT you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every federal income tax withheld amount in box 4 of every Form 1099-INT you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every tax-exempt interest amount in box 8 of every Form 1099-INT you or your spouse received for 2025?

Have you recorded every original issue discount amount in box 1 of every Form 1099-OID you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every market discount amount in box 5 of every Form 1099-OID you or your spouse received for 2025 for which you elected to include market discount in income each year?
Have you recorded every federal income tax withheld amount in box 4 of every Form 1099-R you or your spouse received for 2025?

Have you recorded every Form 1099-R you or your spouse received for 2025 that reports a fully taxable IRA, SEP or SIMPLE distribution (the IRA/SEP/SIMPLE box checked and distribution code 7 in box 7)?
Have you recorded every interest income amount in box 5 of every Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every gambling loss you or your spouse claim for 2025?

Have you recorded every amount of interest you or your spouse received in 2025 that was not reported on any Form 1099-INT (interest reported on a Form 1099-OID or Schedule K-1 is asked about separately)?
Have you listed every child you claim for the credit for other dependents on your 2025 return?
Have you listed every relative you claim for the credit for other dependents on your 2025 return?
Have you recorded every amortizable bond premium adjustment to your 2025 interest income that was not already subtracted on your Form 1099-INT or Form 1099-OID?
Have you recorded every nominee distribution adjustment to your 2025 interest income, meaning interest reported to you that belongs to someone else?
Have you recorded every voluntary federal income tax withheld amount in box 6 of every Form SSA-1099 you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every Form SSA-1099 you or your spouse received for 2025 (not counting a lump-sum election, and not a Form RRB-1099), with its box 3, box 4 and box 5 amounts?
Have you recorded every wage amount in box 1 of every Form W-2 you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every federal income tax withheld amount in box 2 of every Form W-2 you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every Social Security tax withheld amount in box 4 of every Form W-2 you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every Medicare tax withheld amount in box 6 of every Form W-2 you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every winnings amount in box 1 of every Form W-2G you or your spouse received for 2025?
Have you recorded every federal income tax withheld amount in box 4 of every Form W-2G you or your spouse received for 2025?
